name: Drum Whoosh
description: The shortest delays and back, with a little regeneration, for a drum bus that whooshes.

name: Fast Warble
description: A quick, shallow sweep: a warble that sits between a flanger and a vibrato.

name: Gentle Swirl
description: A narrow, slow sweep at the long end with no regeneration, nearer a chorus than a jet.

name: Jet Sweep
description: The whole sweep, slowly, with the regeneration up: the jet plane taking off and landing.

name: Metal Ring
description: Held still with the regeneration full: a fixed comb that rings like a pipe, on drums or a riff.
